rows.ja: アプリ配信・クラウド(供給元)

relations.text: Mercado LibreとMercado Pagoのアプリは、主にApple App Storeなどの第三者アプリストア経由の配信に依存している
relations.text_en: The Mercado Libre and Mercado Pago apps depend on distribution through third-party app stores, primarily Apple's App Store

source.label: MercadoLibre 10-K
source.quote: Our Mercado Libre and Mercado Pago mobile applications depend on distribution through third-party app stores operated by global mobile operating system providers, primarily Apple’s App Store and Google Play.

relations.text: 同アプリは、主にGoogle Playなどの第三者アプリストア経由の配信に依存している

source.quote: Our Mercado Libre and Mercado Pago mobile applications depend on distribution through third-party app stores operated by global mobile operating system providers, primarily Apple’s App Store and Google Play.

relations.text: Google Ad ManagerおよびAdMobとの連携が4月に始まった

source.label: MercadoLibre 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Our integration with Google Ad Manager and AdMob went live in April.

relations.text: 事業運営は、最大のクラウド事業者であるGoogle Cloud Platformなどに大きく依存している
relations.text_en: Its operations depend largely on its cloud providers, the largest of which are Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud Platform

source.label: MercadoLibre annual report
source.quote: Our ability to operate our business on a day-to-day basis largely depends on the efficient operation of our information technology infrastructure and our cloud providers, the largest of which are Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud Platform.

source.label: MercadoLibre annual report

source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 2036年満期の米ドル建て10億ドルの無担保社債の発行を、Citigroupなどが主幹事として主導した
relations.text_en: Citigroup was among the global coordinators and lead book-running managers of its USD 1,000 million 2036 senior unsecured notes

source.label: MercadoLibre の発表
source.quote: The transaction was led by BofA Securities, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley as Global Coordinators and Lead Book-Running Managers, and Allen & Company and Santander as Joint Book-Running Managers.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。
